_about: Sample events for previewing and testing message templates (python -m src.main --preview-... --fixture).
These are NOT real releases and are never written to any database. Names are real Forex Factory event names.
Each event is classified by the real Step 2 rules and compared with its forecast by the real Step 3 logic.
'reference_time_utc' is the moment the preview pretends it is: 09:00 India time on 12 November 2026.
